summary: Recorded the final account from receipt 29f7b510513642f499f8646cb55dccfe and closed the last open consequence: on a five-voter committed configuration the restarted holder reconstructed one voter and acknowledged one payload on a single copy, a majority that never held it elected leadership, a second legal election put that leadership in a strictly higher term, and after the holder was rebuilt the payload was present in no store — comparison 1 holds at parsed index 36 with discarded true, payload_on_holder_after false and copies_after_rejoin 0, and comparison 0 is violated at the same index because the acknowledged commit was not durable on a majority of the committed configuration (the flag-disabled control acknowledged nothing at parsed index 38). Added a fact for that loss, corrected the earlier three-voter fact whose surviving copy proved shape-specific (the successor leadership there was in the same term as the stale holder, so the loss depends on the successor outranking it), withdrew the recorded limitation that the discard was unexercised, and restated the complete account with each result under its own receipt. A following representational fix corrected the promoted reconstruction fact, which said three ladders while listing four shapes: it now names the four (no snapshot; snapshot then RemoveServer; snapshot then Promote back; the demote/promote ladder at three and five voters) and cites the matching receipts. Incomplete: only the recorded boundaries remain — single process with in-memory stores and no crash or network fault model, single-shot windows, one restarted instance per exercise, a synthesized campaign for the vote-path request, and untested reconstruction shapes.
